evals.prompt: Create a PR for my current branch. I fixed the auth middleware to handle expired tokens.
evals.expected_output: Uses `gh pr create` with a descriptive title and body. Pushes branch with -u flag first if needed. Uses HEREDOC for the body. Includes Co-Authored-By line in any commits.

assertions.name: uses-gh-pr-create
assertions.description: Uses `gh pr create` CLI command (not GitHub web UI or API calls)

assertions.name: checks-git-status-first
assertions.description: Runs `git status` and/or `git diff` before creating the PR to understand current state

assertions.name: pushes-branch-before-pr
assertions.description: Ensures branch is pushed to remote (git push -u origin) before creating the PR

evals.prompt: I'm getting 'Bad credentials' from gh even though I'm logged in. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the GITHUB_TOKEN conflict. Checks `gh auth status` for the 'token in GITHUB_TOKEN is invalid' message. Searches shell config for stale GITHUB_TOKEN export. Suggests unsetting it.

assertions.name: diagnoses-github-token-conflict
assertions.description: Identifies that a stale GITHUB_TOKEN env var overrides valid keyring auth (the specific troubleshooting case from the skill)

assertions.name: suggests-unset-and-remove
assertions.description: Suggests both `unset GITHUB_TOKEN` for current session AND removing the export from shell config

evals.prompt: Stage and commit my changes to auth.ts and middleware.ts. The fix resolves issue #42.
evals.expected_output: Stages specific files (not git add -A). Creates commit with 'fix: resolve issue #42' and Co-Authored-By. Uses HEREDOC for commit message.

assertions.name: stages-specific-files-not-all
assertions.description: Uses `git add auth.ts middleware.ts` (specific files) rather than `git add -A` or `git add .` (safety rule)

assertions.name: includes-co-authored-by
assertions.description: Commit message includes Co-Authored-By: Claude line
